details.description: Elevate your meals with the tangy and zesty flavour of Ruchi Magic Lime Pickle. Crafted using fresh, natural yellow lemons and an authentic, age-old recipe, this pickle bursts with traditional Indian flavours. Enjoy its unique taste and texture with a variety of dishes, from curd rice and chips to khakra, farsan and dhokla. The hygienic packaging ensures the product remains fresh over time, allowing you to savour the novelty of this delightful pickle. Indulge in the perfect balance of tanginess and spice that will add an extra zing to all your meals.
details.ingredients: Lime Pieces (60%), Iodized Salt, Water, Refined Rice Bran Oil, Chilli, Mixed Spices, Acidity Regulators (INS 260, INS 330), Asafoetida, CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS I PRESERVATIVE (INS 211)
details.storageInstructions:
*Store in a cool, dry and hygienic place
*Avoid direct sunlight
details.manufacturerName: Kabini Agro Foods India Pvt. Ltd. S. No 432/1 & 433/B Dindal Village & Post

details.description: Made of carefully vetted fresh mangoes from the mango grooves across South India, Ruchi Magic Cut Mango pickle is a taste tangling delightful partake for many when served with snack items like Khakra, Chips and French fries. It is also a yummy appetite when served with nicely roasted crispy Ghee Dosa, thick curd rice and bread.

details.storageInstructions:
* Store in a cool, dry & hygienic place

details.description: Ruchi Pickle - Mango Thokku is made of grated, juicy mangoes and is a delicious, piquant pickle that makes a great accompaniment with dosa, idly and rotis. It is a tongue-tickling, hot and sour combo that tempts you to savour it repeatedly. This pickle is specially made for food lovers.

details.description: Made of traditionally passed recipes, the aromatic and tangy Ruchi Magic Mango Ginger pickle makes your dish delicious and delightful. The look-alike of Ginger with the flavour of Raw Mango, Mango Ginger is certainly a great appetizer when served with Roti, Puri and plain rice topped with ghee.

Mango Ginger Paste, Water, Edile Vegetable Oil, Salt, Water, Tamarind, Jaggery, Chilli, Spices And Condiments, Bengal Gram, Black Gram, Acidity Regulators(E260, E330) And Asafoetida.
Class Ii Preservatives (E211)

details.description: Discover the authentic taste of tradition with Ruchi Magic Pickles. Founded in 1981, this brand has mastered the art of crafting delectable pickles using time-honoured recipes developed over generations. Boasting a tantalising aroma of freshly peeled white garlic cloves, each jar of Ruchi Magic Pickles promises an enriched, traditional flavour that will delight your senses. With eighteen mouth-watering variants to choose from, this large and loyal fan base can attest to the unparalleled authenticity and delectable taste of these pickles, firmly rooted in the rich culinary heritage of India. Indulge in the perfect balance of tradition and taste with Ruchi Magic Pickles.

details.description: Made of plump red tomatoes and curvy white garlic, Ruchi Tomato Garlic pickle is mouthwatering and scrumptious. It provides the heavenly taste of age-old authentic homemade pickle to delight your taste buds. This is the most preferred flavour of the South Indians. Now make your Rotis, Breads and Nachos magical with Ruchi Tomato Garlic pickle.

details.usageInstructions:
1. Can be served with meals or as an interesting condiment. Goes well with all Indian cuisines and dishes. Ideal for travel time too when you need something tangy yet easy to enhance flavours.
2. Eat it with a hot plate of rice and a dollop of ghee to enjoy a delicious meal.
